# Modern Fashion Store

> A demo fashion e-commerce storefront built with React, Redux Toolkit and Vite. Products are sample data and no real orders are taken.

## Pages

- [Home](https://modern-fashion-store-theta.vercel.app/): Featured collections, new arrivals and best sellers
- [Shop all products](https://modern-fashion-store-theta.vercel.app/shop): Browse and filter the full catalog
- [Women](https://modern-fashion-store-theta.vercel.app/shop/women): Women's clothing
- [Men](https://modern-fashion-store-theta.vercel.app/shop/men): Men's clothing
- [Shipping and returns](https://modern-fashion-store-theta.vercel.app/shipping-returns): Delivery and return policy
- [Size guide](https://modern-fashion-store-theta.vercel.app/size-guide): Measurement charts
